title: Swapchain image rendered and presented while still in VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED
fix_note: no upstream fix linked (issue open); the fixed variant follows the issue's proposal: transition UNDEFINED -> COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL before rendering and COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL -> PRESENT_SRC_KHR before presenting
expected_finding: the swapchain image is never transitioned: it is rendered as COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL while its layout is UNDEFINED, and vkQueuePresentKHR presents it in UNDEFINED instead of PRESENT_SRC_KHR (VUID-VkPresentInfoKHR-pImageIndices-01296)
